name: Simple Butter Chicken with Peas & Basmati Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups basmati rice
1 ½ tsp salt
4 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken dry with paper towel, cut into bite-sized (1-inch) pieces, and set aside.
Once the water for the rice is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix spices in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp cumin
1 tbsp coriander
1 tbsp salt
2 tsp cinnamon
1 tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and small dice onions.
Wash, peel, and mince or grate ginger. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onions and cook, stirring constantly, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
Add ginger, garlic, and spices to the onions and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30 seconds.
Using a strainer or colander, drain the diced tomatoes, pressing with the back of a spoon to extract as much liquid as possible; discard liquid.
Add additional butter, chicken, diced tomatoes, and cream to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium; cover and cook until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
177 ml heavy cream

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the frozen peas under running water, then drain. Add peas to the butter chicken, stir, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and butter chicken between bowls; garnish with cilantro and enjoy!
